notes: Sheet rotated: Stock Av. runs down the left side (SSW), Colerain along the bottom, Hopple down the right side, Cormany/Massachusetts/Sidney/Henshaw run across. Names printed 'STOCK AV.', 'CORMANY AV.' (and 'CORMANY AVE.' west of Stock), 'MASSACHUSETTS AV.' (spelt 'MASSACHUSETS AVE.' west of Stock; recorded with the usual spelling), 'SIDNEY AV.', 'HENSHAW AV.', 'HOPPLE', 'COLERAIN AV.'. The strip west of Stock (x < ~450) is the edge of sheet 287's blocks: Cormany, Massachusetts, Sidney and the lower Henshaw come in from the west there and T into Stock. Henshaw meets Stock twice: the 58' Henshaw Av. on this sheet leaves Stock eastward at y ~3994, and Henshaw Av. from the west (sheet 287) meets Stock about 1600 px further south (y ~5843); east of Stock at that point is only a rear lot line. Cormany, Massachusetts and Sidney east of the big triangle stop at a subdivision line at x ~4185 (recorded as ends). Colerain's south line is not drawn; its centre is taken 30 ft (~178 px, scale 100 ft = ~595 px) south of the north building line. Hopple/Colerain is a T on this sheet (the Hopple water pipe continues south across Colerain; on sheet 281 the south leg meets Colerain offset). Henshaw is 50' on the straight east stretch to Hopple. Stock is 60' north of Henshaw and about 27' at Colerain.
